food.name: Fries
sourceNotes: Values are approximate representative placeholders for ruleset tuning, not a clinical nutrient database.

sections.title: Fats
sections.narration: 15 grams of fat. Polyunsaturated fat is 4.5 grams, helping with cell structure and healthy signalling. Saturated fat is 2.3 grams, working against a cleaner fat profile. For tubers, fat usually barely matters unless it has been added.
sections.subtitleText: 15g of fat. Polyunsaturated fat is 4.5g, helping with cell structure and healthy signalling. Saturated fat is 2.3g, working against a cleaner fat profile. For tubers, fat usually barely matters unless it has been added.

sections.title: Carbs
sections.narration: 41 grams of carbs. Starch is 35 grams, supporting useful staple-carb energy. Glycemic index is 75, not great for steadier carb behaviour, so that's a real downside for tubers. For tubers, carb quality decides a lot.
sections.subtitleText: 41g of carbs. Starch is 35g, supporting useful staple-carb energy. Glycemic index is 75, not great for steadier carb behaviour, so that's a real downside for tubers. For tubers, carb quality decides a lot.

sections.title: Proteins
sections.narration: 3.4 grams of protein. That amount is useful enough to count. Essential amino acids score is 5 out of 9, not giving much repair-and-maintenance protein support. For tubers, protein is usually limited, so the other sections have to carry more.

sections.narration: Vitamins are low overall. For tubers, vitamin C and vitamin A matter most.

sections.title: Minerals
sections.narration: Potassium is 13% daily value, useful for fluid balance. Iron is only 4% daily value, not bringing much oxygen-transport support. For tubers, minerals matter most when potassium shows up strongly.

sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: Pros first: strong comfort-food appeal. A very real reason people like them, even if the nutrition fit is weak. Still retains some tuber identity. Not nutritionally empty, just much worse than stronger tuber forms. Satisfying texture and taste. Part of the real-world appeal, especially for content framing.

sections.title: Cons
sections.narration: Cons next: fried format is a major category negative. This drags tubers away from the cleaner energy-food role the category is supposed to reward. Glycemic behaviour is rough. A major practical strike against the food in a carb-behaviour category. Energy density is much harsher than ideal. Much easier to overshoot calories than with cleaner tuber forms.
